report.summary: Patient P-D012 (Hector Alvarado, 47, Medicaid) screened positive for food worry ("sometimes true") on 9/30/2026. He lives in Chicago (Cook County), tract 17031230500 — a low-income area with ~41% food insecurity. He reports no steady housing but no transportation barrier. Four food resources were identified; eligibility was checked where possible and a booking was submitted for Harvest Table Pantry.
